an5.28:1.1: Ariyassa bhikkhave pañcaṅgikassa sammāsamādhissa bhāvanaṃ desessāmi,
an5.28:1.2: taṃ suṇātha sādhukaṃ manasikarotha, bhāsissāmī ti.
an5.28:1.3: Evaṃ bhante ti kho te bhikkhū Bhagavato paccassosum.
an5.28:2.1: Katamā ca bhikkhave ariyassa pañcaṅgikassa sammāsamādhissa bhāvanā? 2.
an5.28:2.2: Idha bhikkhave bhikkhu vivicc'eva kāmehi . . . pe . . . paṭhamaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharati.
an5.28:2.3: So imam eva kāyaṃ vivekajena pītisukhena abhisandeti parisandeti paripūreti parippharati, nāssa kiñci sabbāvato kāyassa vivekajena pītisukhena apphuṭaṃ hoti. 3.
an5.28:2.4: Seyyathā pi bhikkhave dakkho nahāpako vā nahāpakantevāsī vā kaṃsathāle nahāniyacuṇṇāni ākiritvā udakena paripphosakaṃ paripphosakaṃ sanneyya, sā 'ssa nahāniyapiṇḍi snehānugatā snehaparetā santarabāhirā phuṭā snehena na ca paggharati, evam
an5.28:2.5: eva kho bhikkhave bhikkhu imam eva kāyaṃ vivekajena pītisukhena abhisandeti parisandeti paripūreti parippharati,
an5.28:2.6: nāssa kiñci sabbāvato kāyassa vivekajena pītisukhena apphuṭaṃ hoti:
an5.28:2.7: ariyassa bhikkhave pañcaṅgikassa sammāsamādhissa ayaṃ paṭhamā bhāvanā. 4.
an5.28:3.1: Puna ca paraṃ bhikkhave bhikkhu vitakkavicārānaṃ vūpasamā . . . pe . . . dutiyaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharati.
an5.28:3.2: So imam eva kāyaṃ samādhijena pītisukhena abhisandeti parisandeti paripūreti parippharati,
an5.28:3.3: nāssa kiñci sabbāvato kāyassa samādhijena pītisukhena apphuṭaṃ hoti. 5.
an5.28:3.4: Seyyathā pi bhikkhave udakarahado ubbhidodako, tassa nev'assa puratthimāya disāya udakassa āyamukhaṃ na pacchimāya disāya udakassa āyamukhaṃ na uttarāya disāya udakassa āyamukhaṃ na dakkhiṇāya disāya udakassa āyamukhaṃ, devo ca na kālena kālaṃ sammādhāraṃ anuppaveccheyya,
an5.28:3.5: atha kho tamhā ca udakarahadā sītā vāridhārā ubbhijjitvā tam eva udakarahadaṃ sītena vārinā abhisandeyya parisandeyya paripūreyya paripphareyya, nāssa kiñci sabbāvato udakarahadassa sītena vārinā apphuṭaṃ assa,
an5.28:3.6: evam eva kho bhikkhave bhikkhu imam eva kāyaṃ samādhijena pītisukhena abhisandeti parisandeti paripūreti parippharati,
an5.28:3.7: nāssa kiñci sabbāvato kāyassa samādhijena pītisukhena apphuṭaṃ hoti:
an5.28:3.8: ariyassa bhikkhave pañcaṅgikassa sammāsamādhissa ayaṃ dutiyā bhāvanā. 6.
an5.28:4.1: Puna ca paraṃ bhikkhave bhikkhu pītiyā ca virāgā . . . pe . . . tatiyaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharati.
an5.28:4.2: So imam eva kāyaṃ nippītikena sukhena abhisandeti parisandeti paripūreti parippharati,
an5.28:4.3: nāssa kiñci sabbāvato kāyassa nippītikena sukhena apphuṭaṃ hoti. 7.
an5.28:4.4: Seyyathā pi bhikkhave uppaliniyaṃ vā paduminiyaṃ vā puṇḍarīkiniyaṃ vā app ekaccāni uppalāni vā padumāni vā puṇḍarīkāni vā udake jātāni udake saṃvaḍḍhāni udakānuggatāni antonimuggaposīni,
an5.28:4.5: tāni yāva c' aggā yāva ca mūlā sītena vārinā abhisannāni parisannāni paripūrāni paripphuṭāni,
an5.28:4.6: nāssa kiñci sabbāvataṃ uppalānaṃ vā padumānaṃ vā puṇḍarīkānaṃ vā sītena vārinā apphuṭaṃ assa,
an5.28:4.7: evam eva kho bhikkhave bhikkhu imam eva kāyaṃ nippītikena sukhena abhisandeti parisandeti paripūreti parippharati,
an5.28:4.8: nāssa kiñci sabbāvato kāyassa nippītikena sukhena apphuṭaṃ hoti:
an5.28:4.9: ariyassa bhikkhave pañcaṅgikassa sammāsamādhissa ayaṃ tatiyā bhāvanā. 8.
an5.28:5.1: Puna ca paraṃ bhikkhave bhikkhu sukhassa ca pahānā . . . pe . . . catutthaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharati.
an5.28:5.2: So imam eva kāyaṃ parisuddhena cetasā pariyodātena pharitvā nisinno hoti,
an5.28:5.3: nāssa kiñci sabbāvato kāyassa parisuddhena cetasā pariyodātena apphuṭaṃ hoti. 9.
an5.28:5.4: Seyyathā pi bhikkhave puriso odātena vatthena sasīsaṃ pārupitvā nisinno assa,
an5.28:5.5: nāssa kiñci sabbāvato kāyassa odātena vatthena apphuṭaṃ assa,
an5.28:5.6: evam eva kho bhikkhave bhikkhu imam eva kāyaṃ parisuddhena cetasā pariyodātena pharitvā nisinno hoti,
an5.28:5.7: nāssa kiñci sabbāvato kāyassa parisuddhena cetasā pariyodātena apphuṭaṃ hoti:
an5.28:5.8: ariyassa bhikkhave pañcaṅgikassa sammāsamādhissa ayaṃ catutthā bhāvanā. 10.
an5.28:6.1: Puna ca paraṃ bhikkhave bhikkhuno paccavekkhanānimittaṃ suggahitaṃ hoti sumanasikataṃ sūpadhāritaṃ suppaṭividdhaṃ paññāya. 11.
an5.28:6.2: Seyyathā pi bhikkhave añño 'va aññaṃ paccavekkheyya, ṭhito vā nisinnaṃ paccavekkheyya, nisinno vā nipannaṃ paccavekkheyya,
an5.28:6.3: evam eva kho bhikkhave bhikkhuno paccavekkhanānimittaṃ suggahitaṃ hoti sumanasikataṃ sūpadhāritaṃ suppaṭividdhaṃ paññāya:
an5.28:6.4: ariyassa bhikkhave pañcaṅgikassa sammāsamādhissa ayaṃ pañcamā bhāvanā.
an5.28:7.1: Evaṃ bhāvite kho bhikkhave bhikkhu ariye pañcaṅgike sammāsamādhimhi evaṃ bahulīkate yassa yassa abhiññāsacchikaraṇīyassa dhammassa cittaṃ abhininnāmeti abhiññāsacchikiriyāya, tatra tatr'eva sakkhibhabbataṃ pāpuṇāti sati sati āyatane. 12.
an5.28:8.1: Seyyathā pi bhikkhave udakamaṇiko ādhāre ṭhapito pūro udakassa samatittiko kākapeyyo,
an5.28:8.2: tam enaṃ balavā puriso yato yato āvajjeyya, āgaccheyya udakan ti?
an5.28:8.4: Evam eva kho bhikkhave bhikkhu evaṃ bhāvite ariye pañcaṅgike sammāsamādhimhi evaṃ bahulīkate yassa yassa abhiññāsacchikaraṇīyassa dhammassa cittaṃ abhininnāmeti abhiññāsacchikiriyāya, tatra tatr' eva sakkhibhabbataṃ pāpuṇāti sati sati āyatane. 13.
an5.28:9.1: Seyyathā pi bhikkhave same bhūmibhāge pokkharaṇī caturassā ālibaddhā pūrā udakassa samatittikā kākapeyyā,
an5.28:9.2: tam enaṃ balavā puriso yato yato āliṃ muñceyya, āgaccheyya udakan ti?
an5.28:9.4: Evam eva kho bhikkhave bhikkhu evaṃ bhāvite ariye pañcaṅgike sammāsamādhimhi evaṃ bahulīkate yassa yassa abhiññāsacchikaraṇīyassa dhammassa cittaṃ abhininnāmeti abhiññāsacchikiriyāya, tatra tatr'eva sakkhibhabbataṃ pāpuṇāti sati sati āyatane. 14.
an5.28:10.1: Seyyathā pi bhikkhave subhūmiyaṃ cātummahāpathe ājaññaratho yutto assa ṭhito odhastapatodo,
an5.28:10.2: tam enaṃ dakkho yoggācariyo assadammasārathi abhirūhitvā vāmena hatthena rasmiyo gahetvā dakkhiṇena hatthena patodaṃ gahetvā yen' icchakaṃ yad icchakaṃ sāreyya pi paccāsāreyya pi, evam
an5.28:10.3: eva kho bhikkhave bhikkhu evaṃ bhāvite ariye pañcaṅgike sammāsamādhimhi evaṃ bahulīkate yassa yassa abhiññāsacchikaraṇīyassa dhammassa cittaṃ abhininnāmeti abhiññāsacchikiriyāya,
an5.28:10.4: tatra tatr'eva sakkhibhabbataṃ pāpuṇāti sati sati āyatane. 15.
an5.28:11.1: So sace ākaṅkhati ‘anekavihitaṃ iddhividhaṃ paccanubhaveyyaṃ: eko pi hutvā bahudhā assaṃ . . . pe . . . yāva Brahmalokā pi kāyena 'va saṃvatteyyan' ti,
an5.28:11.2: tatra tatr' eva sakkhibhabbataṃ pāpuṇāti sati sati āyatane. 16.
an5.28:12.1: So sace ākaṅkhati ‘dibbāya sotadhātuyā visuddhāya . . . pe . . . ye dūre santike cā' ti,
an5.28:12.2: tatra tatr'eva sakkhibhabbataṃ pāpuṇāti sati sati āyatane. 17.
an5.28:13.1: So sace ākaṅkhati ‘parasattānaṃ parapuggalānaṃ cetasā ceto paricca pajāneyyaṃ:
an5.28:13.2: sarāgaṃ vā cittaṃ sarāgaṃ cittan ti pajāneyyaṃ . . .
an5.28:13.17: avimuttaṃ vā cittaṃ avimuttaṃ cittan ti pajāneyyan 'ti,
an5.28:13.18: tatra tatr'eva sakkhibhabbataṃ pāpuṇāti sati sati āyatane. 18.
an5.28:14.1: So sace ākaṅkhati ‘anekavihitaṃ pubbenivāsaṃ anussareyya, seyyathīdaṃ ekaṃ pi jātiṃ dve pi jātiyo . . . pe . . . iti sākāraṃ sa-uddesaṃ anekavihitaṃ pubbenivāsaṃ anussareyyan' ti,
an5.28:14.2: tatra tatr'eva sakkhibhabbataṃ pāpuṇāti sati sati āyatane. 19.
an5.28:15.1: So sace ākaṅkhati ‘dibbena cakkhunā visuddhena atikkantamānusakena . . . pe . . . yathākammupage satte pajāneyyan' ti,
an5.28:15.2: tatra tatr'eva sakkhibhabbataṃ pāpuṇāti sati sati āyatane. 20.
an5.28:16.1: So sace ākaṅkhati ‘āsavānaṃ khayā anāsavaṃ cetovimuttiṃ paññāvimuttiṃ diṭṭh'eva dhamme sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja vihareyyan' ti,
an5.28:16.2: tatra tatr'eva sakkhibhabbataṃ pāpuṇāti sati sati āyatane
